queue.title: Review payments
queue.subtitle: Review bank transactions and suggestions. Nothing is posted until you explicitly confirm it.

queue.empty: There are no bank transactions with this status.
queue.ignored: The bank transaction was ignored. Nothing was posted.

match.subtitle: {{amount}} with value date {{date}}
match.outgoingHint: Outgoing payments cannot be posted in this version. You can only ignore this transaction.
match.bookingHint: The confirmed payment reduced the open item. Reversing the match creates a reversal and reopens the item.
match.unmatched: The match was reversed and the payment cancelled.
match.unmatchError: The match could not be reversed.
match.suggestionsHint: The ranking supports your review. No suggestion is ever posted automatically.
match.suggestionsError: The suggestions could not be loaded.
match.noSuggestions: No matching suggestion was found. Select open items manually.

match.allocationsHint: Add one or more items and adjust the split amounts. Their sum must equal the bank transaction.

match.noAllocations: No open item has been allocated yet.
match.sumMismatch: The allocation is {{amount}} away from the transaction amount.
match.invalidAllocation: Every allocation must be positive and may not exceed the open amount.
match.neverAutomatic: Only this click posts Bank ↔ Receivable. Confidence, suggestions, and allocations never post automatically.
match.confirmed: The match was confirmed and posted.
match.alreadyConfirmed: This match was already confirmed. The linked payment was loaded.
match.confirmError: The match could not be posted.
